name: Government ID Baseline
description: Government-issued identifier hygiene, covering all 12 identifiers from the competitor parity research: redacts US Social Security Numbers and passport numbers, and requires a written reason for likely matches on US ITIN, UK NINO/NHS/passport, Spain NIF, Italy Codice Fiscale, Australia TFN, India PAN/Aadhaar, and Singapore NRIC/FIN. None of the non-US rules validate the real checksum/lookup-table each country actually uses (RE2 can't do modular arithmetic or lookahead-based exclusion lists) — every one of them is a structural/format heuristic, which is why they're all `justify` rather than `redact` or `request_access`: real false positives are expected, especially on the bare-digit-run identifiers (NHS, UK passport, TFN, Aadhaar) which additionally require a nearby context keyword to fire at all.

rules.name: Redact US Social Security Numbers and passport numbers
rules.description: Scans user prompts, tool call inputs, and tool outputs for US SSNs and 9-digit US passport numbers. Redacts matches and allows execution to proceed with the sanitised data.

rules.name: Require justification for likely US Individual Taxpayer ID Numbers (ITIN)
rules.description: Matches the ITIN format: 9XX-XX-XXXX where the middle group falls in IRS-assigned ranges (70-88, 90-92, 94-99). No independent context signal beyond the digit shape, so treat as a heuristic with real false-positive potential.

rules.name: Require justification for likely UK National Insurance Numbers
rules.description: Matches the NINO format: 2 letters (excluding D/F/I/Q/U/V as the 1st and D/F/I/O/Q/U/V as the 2nd, per HMRC spec), 6 digits, 1 suffix letter (A-D). Does NOT exclude the further HMRC-reserved letter pairs (BG, GB, NK, KN, TN, NT, ZZ) — RE2 has no lookahead to express that exclusion, so this is looser than the official spec.

rules.name: Require justification for likely UK NHS numbers
rules.description: UK NHS numbers are 10 bare digits with a real Mod-11 checksum RE2 can't validate, and a bare 10-digit heuristic would be far too broad — so this only fires when the digits are immediately preceded by an "NHS number"-style keyword.

rules.name: Require justification for likely UK passport numbers
rules.description: UK passport numbers are 9 bare digits with no distinguishing structure, so this only fires when preceded by a "passport number"-style keyword — without that anchor a 9-digit heuristic would fire constantly on unrelated numbers.

rules.name: Require justification for likely Spain personal tax IDs (NIF)
rules.description: Matches 8 digits followed by one of the 23 valid Spanish NIF check letters (TRWAGMYFPDXBNJZSQVHLCKE). Does not validate that the letter is the *correct* one for those specific 8 digits (a real mod-23 computation) — only that it's a letter the scheme actually uses.

rules.name: Require justification for likely Italy personal identification codes (Codice Fiscale)
rules.description: Matches the 16-character Codice Fiscale structure: 6 letters, 2-digit year, 1 valid month letter (A-E/H/L/M/P/R/T), 2-digit day, 1 place-code letter, 3 place-code digits, 1 check letter. Format-only — does not validate the check letter's actual computed value.

rules.name: Require justification for likely Australia Tax File Numbers (TFN)
rules.description: Australian TFNs are 8-9 bare digits with a weighted-mod-11 checksum RE2 can't validate, so this only fires when preceded by a "TFN"-style keyword.

rules.name: Require justification for likely India Permanent Account Numbers (PAN)
rules.description: Matches the PAN structure: 3 letters, 1 holder-type letter from the fixed set (A/B/C/F/G/H/L/J/P/T/K), 1 letter, 4 digits, 1 check letter. Format-only, no checksum validation.

rules.name: Require justification for likely India Aadhaar numbers
rules.description: Matches the Aadhaar shape: 12 digits (optionally grouped 4-4-4), first digit restricted to 2-9 per UIDAI spec. Does not validate the real Verhoeff checksum digit, so still a meaningful false-positive risk on other 12-digit numbers starting 2-9.

rules.name: Require justification for likely Singapore NRIC/FIN numbers
rules.description: Matches the NRIC/FIN shape: a status letter (S/T for citizens and PRs, F/G for foreign work-pass holders, M for the newer FIN series), 7 digits, 1 check letter. Does not validate the real weighted-checksum table that determines the correct check letter for a given digit string.
